strings: (old_name) called a meeting to announce that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} made the hard decision to relinquish leadership and join the elders. Later that night, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/travel/travels} to make it final and {VERB/m_c/are welcomed/is welcomed} back as m_c.

In what seemed like an impulse decision, (old_name) declared that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve had/'s had} enough of the politics and the disrespect. That same night, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} declare {PRONOUN/m_c/self} m_c and join the elders.
